files.description: Repository conventions: multi-module layout, build/test/lint commands, interface segregation, capability dispatch, error mapping, and builder-pattern architecture.
Package-level overview and usage patterns for the Client API.

The core Provider interface, Client capability dispatch, sentinel errors, PaymentRequest/RefundRequest builders (including IdempotencyKey), and the validate -> type-assert -> ErrUnsupported -> call -> wrap-error pattern every optional-capability Client method follows.
The single source of truth for ISO-4217 currencies and minor-unit exponents, plus ParseMajorUnitAmount — the decimal<->minor-unit conversion that has twice had sign-loss bugs near zero.

Documents which capabilities each provider intentionally does not implement and why (e.g. PayPal has no charge-free card-save flow) — check before flagging a provider's non-implementation of an optional interface as a gap.
The linter ruleset already enforced in CI; avoid duplicating what golangci-lint already flags.
